description: Explicit product/provider mappings only. Windows availability is resolved against the embedded trusted catalog at import time; versions, builds, plugins and macOS-only settings are not reproduced.

mappings.detail: Same named upstream product or CLI, mapped to a separately reviewed Windows provider. This does not promise matching versions, binaries, build flags, extensions or configuration.
